The Last Christmas Lantern

Put your Christmas on the page

A Christmas Eve box for a little one
Give the hero familiar things to spot as you read together. Their stripy pyjamas, the stocking Gran knitted or a carrot left by the door can start the adventure.
A book from the grandparents
Let Grandpa be the hero bringing the family’s paper star home through the snow. Choose a younger reading level so a grandchild can follow as someone reads aloud.
A family dedication
Leave a note for the next time the decorations come out. Try “For Evie, Christmas 2026. Our favourite part of Christmas Eve is reading with you. Love, Gran and Grandad.”

Christmas orders and UK delivery

When should I order for Christmas 2026?
For the best chance of Christmas delivery, order by 14 December 2026. Allow time to check your proof and ask for any changes. Arrival by Christmas is an estimate.
When will I see the full proof?
Your full illustrated proof is ready within seven calendar days of payment. After you approve it, printing and UK delivery usually take another 7 to 12 working days. Allow extra time for changes. See ordering and delivery.
What do the hardback sizes cost?
With £3.99 UK postage, the A5 hardback is £28.98 delivered (£24.99 for the book). The larger A4 hardback is £33.98 delivered (£29.99 for the book).
Can I try it before ordering?
Yes. Create a free preview to see the illustrated character and opening pages, then read and edit the words before you buy.

Who’s opening the book on Christmas Eve?

Choose their photo and a festive story idea. Add your own family tradition to make the gift feel familiar from the first page.
